caption: The drawing features a single object, a bonnet or head covering, depicted in profile view, facing left. The main part of the bonnet is colored in deep shades of purple, with highlights and shadows suggesting folds and texture in the fabric. The edge of the bonnet, as well as a long tied portion that hangs down, are rendered in a pale greenish-yellow with a crosshatch and geometric pattern. Small round buttons or fasteners are visible along the bonnet's seam, depicted in a light pinkish shade. In the lower left of the drawing, there is a horizontal ornamental band showing a detail of decorative trim. This trim consists of a series of repeating, simple geometric shapes (pink triangles and rectangles) alternating with short green diagonal lines, arranged in a linear fashion. The entire composition is centered on an off-white background, bordered by a thin, single pink line close to the edge of the paper.
title: Bonnet
